event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Panel composed as per RRS N1.4(b)
facts: The starting sequence for race 3 of ORC C was done with P flag as the preparatory signal.
Wanderlust was observed by the RC vessel on the course side of the starting line at her starting signal.
The race committee displayed flag X with one sound signal 1 second after the starting signal.
Wanderlust did not return to the prestart side of the start line.
The race committee scored Wanderlust OCS in race 3.
conclusions: There was no improper action or ommission from the race committee the criteria of RRS 61.4(b) are not met.
